name: Karl Morgan
source:
Second-year student at Carlson Academy.
The protagonist's best friend and vice-president of the Student Council, which manages the physical education department of the school.
He has high physical ability and also plays the role of escort for the main character.
He has a natural talent for hand-to-hand combat technology, and reigns as an absolute champion in the hand-to-hand combat competition of the Hermes adult division.
Has the nickname "Blood Prince"

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=922863&gc=gcl]Getchu[/url]]
